title: Cross-realm adopted-node teardown lifetime
start_basis: Earliest retained original invalid-free audit; diagnostic work overlaps other iterations.
scope: Retire all wrappers and V8 contexts in a context subtree before releasing its adopted nodes or documents. Preserve existing shared-child xref retention while its parent is alive; release everything when the tab retires.

cause_evidence.source_invariant: A parent-realm wrapper survives node adoption into a child document. Immediate child doc_free clears/frees that document root before the parent wrapped-node list is processed.

deterministic_before125.root_retirement: assertion abort: adopted root freed while parent wrapper remains live

after126.retained_node_ownerDocument_and_attribut: PASS before and after shared-child retirement

cause_evidence.historical_abort: Original stack free(n->attrs[i].value) in node_free_tree; exact historical heap-address causality remains unproven. Non-monotonic old binary outcomes are retained, not treated as fixed evidence.

unchanged_guarded_cleanup.scope: Cleanup diagnostic with completion callback or one-second post-load fallback; not WPT assertion gains or proof of every historical crash cause.

validation.independent_review: Ops reviewed exact wrapper clearing order, xref boundary, ownerDocument lifetime, deduplication and eventual release; conformance ran unchanged browser cleanup repeats.

accepted_candidate.composition: Accepted HEAD including flex and privacy plus geometry125 and this lifetime correction; combined candidate, not a cleanup-only binary.

lifetime_policy: Existing same-origin cross-context bridges mark xref on both contexts and ancestors.
Public retirement of a parented xref context deactivates it but retains its wrappers/document until its tab retires; no new document cache.
Root retirement privately collects all child contexts regardless of xref, then frees deduplicated detached roots while every ownerDocument remains alive, then owned documents.
Top-level page document remains caller-owned and is freed by the existing page lifecycle.
limitations: No blanket memory-safety or crash-free claim.
Historical intermittent invalid-free heap address was not captured; source invariant repair and exact-address attribution remain distinct.
Final full native suite and combined broad replay are separate final gates.
